description: Use when someone has a headcount and either a total or a per-person amount and wants to know what each person gets. Returns the per-person and total amounts, the matching price band, and a link to the guide for that band. This uses the same math as the Corporate Gift Picks budget tool.

amount_type.description: Whether amount is per person or the total for everyone.

headcount.description: Number of people receiving a gift.
